configuration.title: Remote Collector
setting.codexBeacon.codexHome: Codex home in this environment. Empty uses CODEX_HOME, then ~/.codex.
setting.codexBeacon.pythonPath: Python executable without arguments. Defaults to python3 on Linux/macOS; Windows automatically detects the launcher or installed Python.
setting.codexBeacon.sourceLabel: Server/container display label. Empty uses the connection type and hostname; each event carries its own project path.
setting.codexBeacon.collectorEnabled: Read Codex event metadata while this trusted workspace is open.
setting.codexBeacon.cacheRetentionDays: Collector notification-cache retention in this environment (1–30 days). Expiry runs during collection; original conversations are untouched.
